description.narrative: Electoral support by providing technical assistance through IDEA for strengthening of the national and regional electoral bodies. A specific aim of the contribution is to improve gender equality in political participation (candidates) as well among the elected representatives.

Valstöd genom att tillhandahålla tekniskt bistånd genom IDEA för att stärka de nationella och regionala valmyndigheterna. Ett specifikt syfte med insatsen är att förbättra jämställdheten i det politiska deltagandet (kandidater) samt bland de folkvalda representanterna.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The general objective of this intervention was to contribute to the strengthening of an intercultural and participatory democracy in Bolivia, including gender equality at regional and national levels. To this end, improved coordination mechanisms among the National Electoral Body (TSE) and the Regional Bodies (TDE ) were to be developed. Three specific objectives for this contributions were defined as follows: 1. To strengthen the performance of the National Electoral Body (TSE) by promoting its institutional development and TDE's functional decentralisation. 2. To promote an active participation of the TSE in the development of the electoral law through a better coordination among the TSE, the TED and the National Congress. 3. To contribute to the quality of democratic processes by encouraging political participation of women in political and civic organisations. Gender equality in terms of parity and alternation, cultural-ethnic diversity and political pluralism.
